format: Studio / Custom: panel size for ordinal and callback methods
requirement: DanceFlow policy (K1 X-3, not a body rule): ordinal and callback scoring need at least 3 present judges and an odd panel; proficiency needs at least 1. Round readiness (E1), ballot lock (E2) and the engines must apply the same rule.

implementation.symbol_or_migration: at least 3 judges and an odd panel (X-3)

enforcement_point: E2 lock_competition_round_ballots and the engines enforce it; E1 round readiness does NOT (defect: docs/competition/governance/judging-integrity/OD-16-studio-panel-minimum-defect.md).
interpretation_notes: INTERNAL INCONSISTENCY: E1 readiness defaults to a minimum of 1 and ignores parity, so a round can start and then fail to lock; the panel is frozen after start. Correction recommended, not implemented. DanceFlow policy, never presented as a governing-body rule.
decision_refs: OD-16 (owner decision 2026-11-23: Option B now, Option A for future body profiles; retrospective audit PR #795)
